newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico to stage second mining fair in Vancouver.
newsitem.headline: Mexico to stage second mining fair in Vancouver.

text.p: Mexico will host a second mining promotion fair in Vancouver on May 21 to boost mining projects and investments in seven mineral-rich states, the Trade Ministry said Sunday.
Around 150 North American companies will attend the Second Mexico Mining Panel in the Canadian city, the ministry added. The Trade Ministry covers mining activity in Mexico.
The states under the spotlight at this fair are Baja California, Baja California Sur, Guanajuato, Guerrero, Jalisco, Puebla and Veracruz.

At the First Mexico Mining Panel in October, companies pledged to invest $200 million in the state of Guerrero, $20 million in Zacatecas and a total of $15 million in the states of Chihuahua and Durango, the ministry added.
